title: Product Shift — Daily Brief and Launch To-dos
content:
Morning snapshot (2025-02-15)

Top goal: land the PRD edits + canary traffic schedule before EOD, unblock infra for ded. capacity tuning.

Must do immediately:
- [ ] Finalize PRD edits section: rollback criteria, metrics, and dry-run steps. (action: Sophie)
- [ ] Confirm canary window with SRE: 07:30–09:30 PT next Tue. (Rafael to confirm)
- [ ] Add fallback model variant in rollout config (quantized-v2, lower mem profile).

PRD edits notes (rough) — insert into PRD under "Launch safety":
- Metrics to watch: p50/p95 generation latency, error rate (5xx) by model variant, token cost per-response, KV cache hit rate.
- Hard rollback triggers: p95 latency > 600ms for 5 continuous mins OR 5xx rate > 1% over 10m window.
- Soft alerts: increased tail-latency but error rate stable -> hold traffic ramp and alert infra.
- Canary traffic plan: 2% -> 10% -> 25% over 24h, only progress if no hard triggers.
- Data retention note: user prompts from canary should be retained for 7d for eval sampling, flagged in logs. Confirm with security.

Stakeholder follow-ups (quick):
- Maya: check the console dashboard draft for per-route cost breakdown. Ask for one visual mock by Friday.
- Ops: confirm autoscale headroom for dedicated GPUs during launch-day burst (expected +30% qps).
- Sales: share the "what to tell customers" one-pager after canary completes (draft link in linked_artifacts).

Meeting snippets / decisions — Notes from 09:00 sync with infra:
- Kernel selection can be forced per-model for canary to reduce variance; Rafael will push a flag to canary config.
- Temporary increased warmup windows: set KV cache TTL to 10m for the first 6h to reduce cold-start tails.
- If canary latency regresses but throughput holds, try decreasing batch window to 8ms before rolling back.

Quick checklist for launch dry-run:
- [ ] Smoke test route mapping for prod/test namespaces (run smoke-suite: smoke/routing-v2).
- [ ] Validate token accounting on console for sample prompts (use sample set: /evals/launch/dataset-2025-02).
- [ ] Run warm-up script on dedicated pool with synthetic traces (script: infra/tools/warmup/launch.sh).
- [ ] Confirm KMS rotation window doesn't overlap scheduled rollouts.

Risks / things to watch:
- Model variant mismatch: make sure client SDK pins model id used in canary. If not, use routing policy to pin to exact sha.
- Billing surprise: early traffic leak could double expected per-token spend. Keep cost guardrails in place (daily cap).
- Audit trail: ensure we have event logs for rollout decisions (who toggled what + timestamp).

Personal ops & reminders (notes to self):
- Block 10:30–11:30 for PRD polish + review with Maya.
- Ping legal about data retention clause for canary samples (short note: why 7d needed for eval).
- Get lunch — bring something light (avoiding heavy coffee today) — actually: pack snack beforehand.

Evening quick capture (end-of-day):
- What moved: Drafted rollback criteria and canary schedule. Rafael added kernel flag to canary branch.
- Open: Still waiting on SRE confirmation of burst capacity numbers; can't finalize autoscale policy until that lands.
- Tomorrow focus: consolidate PRD final language, circulate to stakeholders, lock embargo window for release notes.

Loose ideas (brainstorming bullets):
- Could expose a "preview latency simulator" in Console that runs model profiles with synthetic distributions so PMs can eyeball tail risk without live canary. Low priority but sticky product idea.
- Consider a "cost threshold" policy in rollout config that automatically throttles traffic if spend >= X% of expected daily budget.

Random capture: if we run into KV cache invalidation bugs, capture a minimal repro and escalate to Research (Maya + Rafael) with timings and first/next-token samples.

End.
